title: Vladimir Putin dresses down Russia's spy chief - BBC News
summary: A BBC News clip of Putin pressing Russian foreign intelligence chief Sergei Naryshkin to speak clearly during a televised meeting on recognizing the rebel-held Ukrainian regions in February 2022.
why: HN cites it as a glimpse of a fearful, disorganized Russian leadership just before the invasion of Ukraine.

quote.text: it subtly presents a leadership structure within the Russian government that is both disorganized, and systemically fearful of Putin
